column3: False positive (reviewed 2026-11-11, see docs/operations/zap.md): the 1=1 and 1=2 payloads get byte-identical 400 answers (UUID pipe runs first; body is zod-validated and the query parameterised); the differing responses ZAP saw are the per-route rate limit switching to 429 after 300 requests/min
